name: student-os
description: StudentOS monorepo (npm workspaces): apps/web, apps/api, packages/shared

scripts.build: npm run build -w @student-os/shared && npm run build -w @student-os/api && npm run build -w @student-os/web
scripts.prepare: npm run build -w @student-os/shared && npm run prisma:generate -w @student-os/api
